sentences.text: The in-force UCB pre-payment-charge provisions say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered cases, but they do not state any RBI monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges.
The older foreclosure-charge circulars have been superseded, so they do not provide a current penalty amount on the as-of date.

missing.slot: monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: Searched the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 pre-payment-charge provisions and the superseded foreclosure-charge circulars; no RBI monetary penalty amount was stated.
